findings: Chunk update retains last full block until it knows whether more input follows, zero-pads buffer and applies start/end flags at output. Zero-length update returns before null pointer memcpy.

Wide subtree compression preserves at least two chaining values on degree-one path to avoid premature root compression. Lazy CV stack merging preserves final root flags and extendable output when input arrives in whole subtrees.

Finalization works on const hasher state, folds pending stack to root and supports unaligned seek offset plus complete output blocks/tail. Zero output length returns before touching output. Reset keeps key/domain mode while clearing chunk counter and stack.

Long-input path uses power-of-two subtree sizes aligned to prior chunk count; this allows full subtree work instead of one-chunk updates. This design observation is not a measured optimization for our workload.

executed_control.scope: Portable same-implementation one-shot versus streaming consistency. Not independent cryptographic oracle, SIMD/keyed/derive-key qualification or throughput measurement.
